# OpenTrawl

> Spotlight for the Agentic OS. OpenTrawl is an open-source (MIT), local-first macOS app and CLI (`trawl`) that indexes 11 personal sources into private SQLite archives under `~/.opentrawl` so any AI agent can search a person's real history read-only from the terminal.

OpenTrawl runs locally on the user's Mac with no OpenTrawl servers, no account, and no telemetry. Every source keeps its own SQLite archive alongside a unified full-text index (`index.db`) and an optional Apple Silicon local semantic index (`semantic.db`).

- Mac app download: https://github.com/opentrawl/opentrawl/releases/latest/download/OpenTrawl.dmg
- Bundled CLI path on macOS: `/Applications/OpenTrawl.app/Contents/Helpers/trawl`
- Discover cold: run `trawl` or `trawl --help`
- Exit codes: `0` complete, `1` failed, `2` bad usage, `3` partial result with usable stdout

## Documentation

- [Full LLM Reference](https://opentrawl.sh/llms-full.txt): Complete CLI, architecture, 11-source, and plugin reference for the current release
- [Apps & Plugins](https://opentrawl.sh/plugins.html): Built-in sources, standalone plugins, and the plugin authoring prompt
- [Privacy & Encryption](https://opentrawl.sh/security.html): Local privacy boundary today and planned end-to-end encrypted sync and cloud tiers
- [Plugin Authoring Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/opentrawl/opentrawl/main/skills/build-trawl-plugin/SKILL.md): Build and install standalone external plugins with `trawl plugin install`
- [Vision](https://github.com/opentrawl/opentrawl/blob/main/docs/vision.md): Product direction, Bitter Lesson substrate principles, and privacy levels
- [Trawler Control Contract](https://github.com/opentrawl/opentrawl/blob/main/docs/contract.md): Protobuf boundary, typed records, links, and output rules

## 11 Built-in Sources (v0.1.21)

- `imessage`: Apple Messages conversations and messages
- `whatsapp`: WhatsApp Desktop chats, groups, messages, and media details
- `telegram`: Telegram for macOS chats and messages
- `mail`: Apple Mail and iCloud Mail accounts
- `gmail`: Gmail mailbox via direct read-only Google OAuth (`trawl gmail connect`)
- `notes`: Apple Notes folders, notes, attachments, and recovered versions
- `contacts`: Apple Contacts and cross-source people resolution
- `calendar`: Apple Calendar events, calendars, and attendees
- `photos`: Apple Photos dates, places, albums, cameras, people tags, and favourites
- `money`: Bank accounts, balances, and transactions
- `twitter`: X posts, bookmarks, likes, mentions, and direct messages

## Quick CLI Surface (v0.1.21)

- Core read-only CLI: `trawl status`, `trawl search`, `trawl open LINK`, `trawl around TARGET`, `trawl who NAME`, `trawl conversations`, `trawl messages --conversation=LINK`
- Source & power commands: `trawl update`, `trawl semantic status|enable|build|disable`, `trawl plugin list|install|remove`, `trawl index status|rebuild`

## Optional

- [Gmail Privacy Policy](https://opentrawl.sh/privacy): Local-first storage and downstream AI boundary
- [Source Code (MIT)](https://github.com/opentrawl/opentrawl): Go CLI, crawlers, protobuf contracts, and SwiftUI Mac app
- [Agent Keyring](https://keyring.opentrawl.sh/): Companion tool for human-approved agent sign-ins using Apple Passwords
